From: Philip Levine for Mayor <1
To: jeevacation@gmail.com
Subject: Swearing-in Ceremony - Monday, November 25th
Date: Sat, 23 Nov 2013 17:33:30 +0000

Philip Levine Mayor Miami Beach

Dear Friends and Neighbors,
Our campaign has been fueled by strong supporters like you. I'd like to
personally thank you for all you have done and continue to do.
On Monday, November 25th please join us at 11:00 am at City Hall (1700
Convention Center Drive, 3rd Floor) for the official swearing-in ceremony

EFTA01141245

 for Commissioners-elect Grieco, Malakoff, Steinberg and for myself.
Please be advised that seating in the Commission Chamber is very limited
and I apologize in advance if the Chamber is at capacity.
The opportunity to serve as Mayor of Miami Beach is an amazing and
humbling honor, and I will do everything I can to make ours the best city
in America.
Once again, I thank you from the bottom of my heart for this victory,
which we have achieved together.
I hope to see you on Monday.
Sincerely,
Philip
